name: Berkeley-East Bay Humane Society - Spay the Bay
description: Low-cost spay/neuter ($150-$450) with free microchip, plus low-cost vaccine clinics
fullDescription: Berkeley Humane's Spay the Bay program provides low-cost spay/neuter surgery and vaccine clinics for Bay Area dog and cat guardians who are struggling financially. Services are currently located inside PetSmart in Pinole while the Berkeley location is closed for construction.
whatTheyOffer:
- Low-cost spay/neuter by appointment: cat neuter $150, cat spay $175, dog neuter $300, dog spay $450
- Includes exam, surgery, post-op pain medication, and a free microchip
- Add-on rabies vaccine if needed ($25 dogs, $35 cats)
- Low-cost core vaccine clinics on select Fridays (no appointment needed; free microchip with a vaccine)
- For owned dogs and cats ages 4 months to 5 years; cats 3 lbs+, dogs 4-45 lbs; no flat-faced breeds
- Limit of 3 pets per household per year
howToGetIt:
1. Review the eligibility rules and process on the Spay the Bay page
2. Submit an online appointment request (current wait is about 1-2 months)
3. Staff will contact you to set a date and collect a non-refundable deposit ($30 per cat, $90 per dog) that goes toward the cost
4. Bring your pet to 1380 Fitzgerald Drive, Pinole (inside PetSmart) on your appointment day
5. For vaccines, check the clinic dates listed on the page, fill out the request form, and arrive during clinic hours
